description: Show one asset with every frame: frame ids, types (animation, rotations - 8-way, edit - text, layer…), names, facings and image keys. Frame ids are what frameIndex/items/frameId take elsewhere; image keys are what referenceFile and end_frame take, on this asset or any other of yours. Long clips show their first and last key; pass frameId to list every key of that frame. Each key downloads at its exact pixels from https://cdn.voidless.dev/<key>. Also its world height (in heights of the hero / its set's reference character) and each frame's sprite_scale (how big the character is drawn there against the base: video clips are usually ~0.57): size it in a game from these, never by eye. Free.

frameId.description: Show only this frame, with every image key

id.description: Asset ID (from list_assets / get_asset or a previous result)

name: get_asset
